boundary: Draft qualitative summaries for independent source review. No publication or experiment reproduction claimed.

summary_override.summary_en: EmoHarness uses a Builder to revise prompts, settings and restricted verification code from a frozen student model’s failure traces. A separate validation split decides whether a candidate replaces the current Harness for later rounds. Most gains come from audio evidence, and the incremental evolution gains do not survive multiple-comparison correction. Human developers inspected some evaluation items, so the evaluation is not an untouched holdout.
summary_override.summary_zh: EmoHarness让Builder依据冻结学生模型的失败轨迹修改提示、配置和受限验证代码，用独立验证集决定是否替换当前Harness，并将采用版本留给后续改进轮。主要收益来自音频证据，演化增量未通过多重比较校正；人工开发曾查看部分评测项，因此不能将全部评测称为从未触碰的留出集。

summary_override.summary_en: LASER represents observation skills as structured instructions and uses discrepancies between generated and reference captions to revise a responsible field or add a skill. A candidate replaces the library only when it improves caption quality without increasing contradictions on a selection set containing different videos. Later rounds reuse the accepted library. Model parameters stay fixed, and evaluation freezes the library; the evidence concerns video object-state description.
summary_override.summary_zh: LASER把观察技能表示为结构化指令，根据生成描述与参考描述的差异，修订负责的指令字段或增建技能。候选在不同视频组成的选择集上改善描述质量且不增加矛盾时才替换技能库，后续轮次复用；模型参数保持固定，最终评测冻结技能库。证据限定于视频物体状态描述。

summary_override.summary_en: SAT uses a teacher to write reusable procedural skills from student failure traces and diagnostic probes. Positive utility on development tasks governs admission or replacement of generic skills. After the teacher leaves, the fixed student and base executor reuse the library on later tasks. Benefits depend on the student and delivery method. Evaluation covers new instances of task families seen during preparation, not arbitrary domain transfer.
summary_override.summary_zh: SAT教师根据学生的失败轨迹和诊断探测，编写可复用的程序性技能指令；开发任务上的正效用决定技能是否入库或替换通用技能。教师退出后，固定学生与执行框架在后续任务中继续使用技能库。收益依赖学生及技能投递方式，验证范围是准备阶段已见任务族的新实例，不能外推为任意领域迁移。

summary_override.summary_en: RoboACE alternates revisions to curriculum-selection and execution Harnesses around frozen foundation models. Optimizers inspect independent-run feedback, revise prompts, tool interfaces and procedural skills, and compare versions on fixed task snapshots before retention. The qualifying objects are the selection and execution methods, not the curriculum tasks themselves. Results cover one development trajectory and fixed panels within the LIBERO ecosystem; final evaluation does not select versions.
summary_override.summary_zh: RoboACE在冻结基础模型外，交替修改课程选择与任务执行的Harness。优化器读取独立运行的反馈，修订提示、工具接口和程序技能，再用固定任务快照比较并保留版本；纳入的是选择和执行的方法修改，课程任务本身不计作Harness。结果来自单条开发轨迹及LIBERO生态的固定评测子集，最终评测不参与版本选择。

summary_override.summary_en: FGSE turns execution experience into bounded prompt or tool-policy patches with explicit preconditions. It tests temporary changes on transfer, falsification and archived regression probes before committing, narrowing the scope and retrying, or rejecting them. Accepted changes are reused on later tasks and can be removed from retrieval after violations. Inclusion is limited to the explicit prompt/tool-policy branch, not all memory content; theoretical guarantees depend on the stated assumptions.
summary_override.summary_zh: FGSE把执行经验转为带适用前提的有限提示或工具策略补丁，在临时状态下测试迁移、反例和历史回归，再提交、缩小适用范围重试或拒绝。通过的行为修改在后续任务中复用，出现违例可停止检索。这里只收录明确的提示/工具策略修改分支，不把所有记忆内容都算作Harness；理论保证依赖论文所列假设。

summary_override.summary_en: NCP studies verified admission and persistence of external control rules. Execution telemetry generates candidates, and a verifier binds evidence to the rule and current policy version before admission or rejection; temporary weight interventions are restored after each request. All candidates were rejected in the actual microbenchmark, leaving the active policy and final outputs unchanged. This is control-layer framework and negative-result evidence; promotion in controlled tests does not establish self-improvement on real tasks.
summary_override.summary_zh: NCP研究外部控制规则的验证准入与持久化：执行遥测生成候选规则，验证器将结果绑定到规则和当前策略版本，再决定采用或拒绝；每次请求结束恢复临时权重干预。真实微基准里所有候选都被拒绝，活动策略和最终结果均未改变。它提供控制层框架及负结果证据，受控测试中的晋升不代表真实任务实现了自我改进。

summary_override.summary_en: Before task learning, RoboScript segments the collected demonstrations and asks a coding agent to write environment-specific skills for gaps in the existing action interface. An independent driver replays the skills, checks transfer across layouts, and rechecks gains against regressions. Coverage feedback drives further rounds before the skill library is frozen for later tasks. Inclusion is limited to this executable tool-skill construction and selection loop, separate from ordinary Task Memory content updates. The paper does not isolate the contribution of skill construction, and continual failure-driven skill creation during deployment remains future work.
summary_override.summary_zh: RoboScript 在任务学习前把汇集的示范拆为动作片段，将现有接口无法覆盖的缺口交给 coding agent 编写环境技能。独立 driver 回放、检查跨布局复用并复查新增技能的得失，按覆盖反馈迭代后冻结技能库，供后续任务调用。这里仅将可执行工具技能的构建与筛选闭环纳入 Harness；普通 Task Memory 内容更新另计。论文未单独量化技能构建的贡献，部署中遇到失败再持续生成新技能仍是未来工作。
